title.es: Casa moderna blanca en la playa

generated.description: A modern two-storey beach house with a white snow-block exterior, birch plank accents, and stone brick stairs and walls, set on a grassy lot beside a sandy shore and water. It measures about 66 blocks wide, 56 deep, and 25 high, built from roughly 14,000 blocks. Inside there is a furnace, and glowstone provides lighting; the source has no description beyond its title.
